scripts.test:airflow: uv run --with-requirements airflow/requirements.txt --with pytest==8.4.2 pytest -q airflow/tests --ignore airflow/tests/test_history_backfill.py
scripts.test:backfill: docker compose exec -T airflow sh -c '/opt/jobs/bin/pip install -q pytest==8.4.2 && cd /opt/airflow && /opt/jobs/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_history_backfill.py'
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm check:architecture && pnpm test
